scope: RewindBox Pocket skins revised in place again (PR #169, the windows at the game's ratio, merged by the integration session as one merge after the PR #166 and PR #167 revision): six of the seven packs of assets/skins/pocket are rebuilt by RewindBox's own generators (tools/skins/build_pocket_skins.py, build_pocket_board_originals.py, build_switch_pocket.py, with tools/skins/screen_opening.py reframe); none is added or removed and ps2-pocket is byte-identical. The window each body draws is redrawn at the game's ratio (4:3; Switch Pocket 16:9): the largest rounded rectangle of that ratio inside the drawn opening, centred, with the drawn corner radius; where it is smaller, the drawn rim's profile is laid along the new edge and the surrounding body is carried inward from the same body pixels (lettering, controls and Switch Pocket's coloured rails left out of the fill); screens[0].screenCutout and outputFrame follow, outputFrame exactly at that ratio. wii-pocket and gamecube-pocket now carry one body per layout (body-standard-*.png, screens/standard-*.png), each the approved raw image away from its redrawn window (checked by tools/skins/verify_pocket_skins.py); the three Originals and Switch Pocket redraw their body without touching any control sprite pixel (asserted by their generators). Controls, frames, touch areas and items are unchanged; every pixel comes from the bodies and designs already reviewed (Pocket originals, PS2 Pocket, board Originals, PS2 Pocket - Original, Switch Pocket). Console names and marks belong to their owners. No third-party artwork or font bundled. No skin overlay or bridge source changes (a CI test of the MeloNX skin overlay changes its upright test-pattern minimum only). Verification tools only: numpy and scipy in the skin checks' private environment, not bundled. No hosted package, dependency, framework, engine, Core or vendored native source change.
